provenance.adapter: DV_eletric load/unload; LPS low-pressure; Oil_level low-oil; changed combined state only
provenance.truth: Four compressor leak reports, not sensor-generated labels
limitations: Single compressor, four failures: no population confidence interval
Already explored historically; this is a frozen-model transfer diagnostic, not a fresh lockbox
Different equipment and event semantics; probabilities may not transfer
No observed Неисправен state: production failure-history features remain at their cold-start values
Report end timestamps used as given; exact return-to-service times are not independently verified

simulation.scope: synthetic physical scenarios; not evidence of field accuracy
simulation.parameters_source: Explicit engineering assumptions, not fitted to predictions or observed test results
limitations: Simple mass balance; no pump curves or calibrated site geometry
Fault/event times and scenario mix are artificial, not operational prevalence
Only pump, flood and phase models tested; no fan/smoke/alarm model claims
Offline ML test, not an API/UI latency or notification delivery test
Bootstrap reflects simulator variation only, not uncertainty in real-world accuracy

bootstrap.unit: paired simulation seed across all scenarios
bootstrap.caution: All-zero outcomes yield a degenerate [0,0] bootstrap interval; this does not prove zero population recall.
